signal_evidence.services_demand: Gross bookings grew 22% year-over-year to more than $58 billion, above the high end of our guidance and marking our fourth consecutive quarter above 20% growth.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We talked about 120,000 vehicle commitments that we are looking to deliver over the next few years... we are looking at up to $10 billion of multiyear AV investment.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: There are deliberate investments... largely a function of some investments in our lower-cost offerings; mobility operating income margin remains very strong at 7.6%.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We continue to hold our expectation for the remainder of the year [for U.S. mobility acceleration]; trailing 12-month free cash flow exceeding $10 billion for the first time in our history.
